description: Who is in an audience? (read-only, Snap's Audience Insights) For a targeting you describe (countries, ages, gender, interests), shows which age groups, genders, languages, interests and devices appear MORE or LESS than in the comparison audience (default: everyone in the same countries), with an index (1.5 = 50% more likely). Use it to choose targeting or to understand who your ads reach. Changes nothing.

category.description: Only one kind of insight: demo, geo, device, interest, engagement, aggregated

gender.description: MALE, FEMALE or leave empty for everyone.

interests.description: Interest ids such as SLC_11 (see snap_targeting_options)

max_age.description: Oldest age, up to 50 (50 means 50 and over).

os_type.description: iOS or ANDROID, or leave empty for both.

name: snap_audience_insights
